messages:
maria: Heads-up — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4932 to change on‑prem auth flow (reduce SA scope + move KMS calls into sidecar). Need security + privacy review before merge. Diff touches Vault integration and VPC egress rules. ETA for merge: tomorrow 11:00 PT if no blockers.
sam: @maria thanks — I'll take security review today. Main things I'll check: token projection, SA least-privilege, and any env vars written in plain text. :eyes:
devon: quick skim — looks mostly fine but I'm worried about what happens if the sidecar crashes. Who owns the canary/rollback plan?
jess: assigning me for privacy review. Are any user PII fields passed during the auth exchange?
maria: @jess no user PII — only tenant_id and service metadata. Added unit + e2e tests that mask tenant_id in logs.
sam: can you paste the sidecar config snippet for how KMS creds are mounted? want to confirm we don't surface key URIs in node envs.
maria: ```yaml
sidecar:
  volumes:
    - name: kms-creds
      secret: kms-key-ref
  env:
    - name: KMS_KEY_URI
      valueFrom: secretRef(kms/key_uri)
```
devon: that looks fine. Recommend adding a circuit-breaker and explicit health-check so auth failures don't silently cascade.
jess: privacy OK pending one small doc update about retention and log redaction. Can you add a short blurb to the PR description?
security-bot: automated secret-scan: no high-severity findings.
sam: I'll add one inline comment about narrowing the SA IAM role (drop cloudkms.cryptoSign if unused). If @maria can address by EOD I'll approve.
maria: will make the IAM tweak, add health-check, and update PR desc now. Ping when done. If we get 2 approvals before 11:00 PT I'll merge; otherwise we'll slot into next merge window.
maria: ping @sam @jess — updated PR with docs, healthcheck probe, and IAM narrowing. Ready for final review and approval. :thumbsup:
